children.claim: For a power of two $t$ dividing $2r$ put $\omega_t=y^{2r/t}$ and define $(F_t^-z)_j=\frac1t\sum_{k}\omega_t^{-jk}z_k$ and $(F_t^+z)_j=\frac1t\sum_k\omega_t^{jk}z_k$; every power of $\omega_t$ is an isometry for the coefficient norm, so both transforms are contractions.
Character cancellation: $\sum_{k=0}^{t-1}\omega_t^{jk}=t$ if $t\mid j$ and $0$ otherwise, whence $F_t^+F_t^-=t^{-1}I$.

For $t\nmid j$ write $j=2^vj_0$ with $j_0$ odd; replacing $k$ by $k+t/2^{v+1}$ modulo $t$ permutes the summands and multiplies the sum by $y^{rj_0}=-1$, so the sum is zero because the additive group of $\mathcal R_r$ has no two-torsion.

The decimation-in-frequency step pairs $z_k$ with $z_{k+t/2}$, applies $H_0=\frac12\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\1&-1\end{pmatrix}$, multiplies the high output by the twiddle $\omega_t^{-k}$ and recurses on both halves, computing $(F_t^-z)_{2h+b}=\frac1{t/2}\sum_k(\omega_t^2)^{-hk}\omega_t^{-bk}\frac{z_k+(-1)^bz_{k+t/2}}2$.

After all $a=\log_2t$ rounds the slots from high to low hold the frequency bits from low to high, so $(F_t^-z)_j$ sits in slot $\operatorname{rev}_a(j)$; the record permutation $B_t$ moving the entry at $j$ to $\operatorname{rev}_a(j)$ is never executed.

The consuming procedure traverses the recursion in reverse: since $H_0^2=I/2$ each reversed level is half the inverse of its forward level, so the reverse procedure composed with $B_tF_t^-$ is $2^{-a}I=I/t$; the two exact procedures implement $B_tF_t^-$ and $F_t^+B_t^{-1}$.

For $D$ axes the twiddles of different axes commute with the other axes' butterflies, so a round is one parallel butterfly $\mathcal H$ followed by one monomial $J_E$ multiplying each record by $y^E$ with $E=-\sum_i\frac{2r}{u_i}b_ik_i\pmod{2r}$ depending only on the address; the opposite round is $\mathcal HJ_E^{-1}$.

children.claim: With $h_p=2^{-p}$ an error of $a$ means absolute error below $ah_p$; a linear contraction propagates input error without increasing it, and for a bilinear contraction $\|\mathcal M(f',g')-\mathcal M(f,g)\|\le\|f'-f\|\|g'\|+\|f\|\|g'-g\|$, so with disk operands the two errors add.

A computed phase product with $|\widetilde e-e|<2h_p$ and $x$ in the disk satisfies $\|Q_p(\widetilde ex)-ex\|<(2\|x\|+\sqrt2)h_p<4h_p$ and $\|Q_p(\widetilde ex)\|\le\|x\|$, so smaller operand norms survive twists and endpoint phases.

Ring convolution: two normalized forwards, pointwise product divided by $r$ and the opposite transform have total error below $(3\log_2T+2)h_p$ before the exact scale $M$, so $E_{\rm ring}:=M(3\log_2T+2)<5T\log_2T$, and with one operand of norm at most $.7$ the output norm is below $.7+5T\log_2T\,h_p<.701$.

Complex convolution with twists: the two input twists contribute less than $4$ each and the output untwist less than $4$ in units of $h_p$, giving $\|\widetilde{\mathcal M}_{\mathbb C}-\mathcal M_{\mathbb C}\|<(E_{\rm ring}+12)h_p<6T\log_2T\,h_p$ and a disk output of norm $<.701$.

Chirp transform: kernel error $<2$, first endpoint product $<4$, computed convolution $<6T\log_2T$ and last endpoint product $<4$ give $\|\widetilde{\mathscr C}(x)-QF_{\boldsymbol t}x\|<8T\log_2T\,h_p$ and $\|\widetilde{\mathscr C}(x)\|<.701$ for $\|x\|\le.6$.

Source transform: the computed expansion has error below $dp^2$ and norm below $.51$, the error before the scale is below $2dp^2+8T\log_2T$, and after the exact scale $2^\gamma$ the error is below $E_sh_p$ with $E_s=9\cdot2^\gamma T\log_2T$ (using $2dp^2<T\log_2T$) and norm below $.501$.

Pointwise product: with $U=RF_{\boldsymbol s}u$ and $V_1=RF_{\boldsymbol s}v$ of norm below $1/4$, the computed arrays have norm below $.26$, $z=Q_p(\widetilde U\cdot\widetilde V_1)$ has norm at most $.26^2<.5$ and $\|z-U\cdot V_1\|<(2E_s+2)h_p$, by splitting the difference and adding one truncation.
Opposite transform: with $G=RF_{\boldsymbol s}^+$ and $G(U\cdot V_1)=(u*v)/S^2$ by permutation cancellation, $\|\widetilde{\mathscr F}^+(z)-G(U\cdot V_1)\|<(3E_s+2)h_p$.

After the exact multiplication by $S$ the array $\widetilde w$ approximates $w=(u*v)/S$ with error below $E_wh_p$, $E_w:=S(3E_s+2)<28\cdot2^\gamma T^2\log_2T$; each coefficient of $w$ is an average of $S$ products so $\|w\|<1/16$ and $\|\widetilde w\|<1/16+10^{-3}<1$.

The unscaled integer coefficient array is $2^{2b+4}Sw$, so using $S\le T<2^b$ and $\log_2T<b$ the final absolute error is below $2^{2b+4}S\cdot28\cdot2^\gamma T^2\log_2T\cdot2^{-6b}<448b\,2^{-b+\gamma}\le448b\,2^{-3b/4}<\frac12$, because $\gamma\le b/4$.

children.claim: Carry propagation with $Q_0=2^b$: $k_0=0$, $d_j=(c_j+k_j)\bmod Q_0$, $k_{j+1}=\lfloor(c_j+k_j)/Q_0\rfloor$.
The carries satisfy $0\le k_j\le q(Q_0-1)<Q_0^2$ by induction, since $c_j+k_j\le q(Q_0-1)^2+q(Q_0-1)=qQ_0(Q_0-1)$.

The invariant $\sum_{h<j}c_hQ_0^h=\sum_{h<j}d_hQ_0^h+k_jQ_0^j$ shows that the digits $d_h$ are the radix-$2^b$ digits of the product; since the product is below $2^{2n}$ all bits above position $2n-1$ are zero and exactly $2n$ bits are output.
